mutants.why: R3: the signed frame leaves before it is durable; a crash re-derives a different frame at the same height (equivocation)
R3: a command is acknowledged to its user when applied in memory; a crash loses it
R2: the J cursor is made durable when an event is read, not with the frame that applies it; a crash loses the event
mutants.old:
inbox' = inbox.union(Set(jKey(mem.cursor + 1))),
    mem' = mem, disk' = disk,
mutants.new:
inbox' = inbox.union(Set(jKey(mem.cursor + 1))),
    mem' = { ...mem, cursor: mem.cursor + 1 }, disk' = { ...disk, cursor: mem.cursor + 1 },

mutants.why: R2: the durable write of a frame leaves the cursor behind the history it applied
R2: an input that was applied is applied again when it arrives again
R1: the frame applies its inputs in another order than the canonical one
R1: a frame opens with nothing due (no idle gate)
